description: Test classes that are NOT executed when the baseline is collected because they hang or cannot run in the build sandbox. They are excluded on the Maven command line (-Dsurefire.excludesFile, generated by collect-baseline.sh) - never by editing a pom or a test - and are listed in test-baseline.json under repos.<repo>.environment_exclusions instead of in the module counts.

exclusions.symptom: the surefire fork never finishes: embedded Cassandra blocks forever in CommitLog segment allocation; each class was verified individually (JDK 17.0.20.1, serial) and was killed by -Dsurefire.timeout=90 with 'There was a timeout or other error in the fork' and 0 reports
exclusions.expected_follow_up: a later milestone replaces cassandra-unit with Testcontainers; remove this entry when the classes run again
